title.en: Profit and loss account and operating profit
title.kn: ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಲಾಭ

heading.en: From gross profit to net profit

hook.en: The store made ₹72,000 gross profit. After paying salaries, rent and interest, how much is really left for the owner?
hook.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿ ₹72,000 ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಗಳಿಸಿತು. ಸಂಬಳ, ಬಾಡಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ನಂತರ ಮಾಲೀಕನಿಗೆ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Prepare a profit and loss account.

narration.en: The store made ₹72,000 gross profit. After paying salaries, rent and interest, how much is really left for the owner?

body.en: It starts with gross profit on the credit side. Debit side: indirect expenses (office and administration such as salaries, rent, printing; selling and distribution such as carriage outwards, advertising; financial such as interest on loan; and losses such as loss by fire, depreciation). Credit side: other incomes such as discount received, commission received, interest and dividend received. The balance is net profit or net loss, transferred to capital.

narration.kn: ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆಯ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಆದಾಯಗಳು, ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪರೋಕ್ಷ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಬರುತ್ತವೆ. ಬಾಕಿಯೇ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟ.

title.en: On the board: Profit and loss account

say.en: The P&L account starts with gross profit on the credit side, with other incomes.
Indirect expenses go on the debit side: office, selling and financial expenses.
Losses such as loss by fire are also debited. The balance, 37,000, is net profit.
Operating profit removes non-operating items: add back interest and fire loss, take out the dividend.

body.en: Operating profit is the profit from the normal business operations. It excludes non-operating items such as interest on loans, loss on sale of assets, loss by fire, dividends and interest received on investments, and profit on sale of assets.

points.en: Add back non-operating expenses and losses

narration.en: Operating profit is the profit from the normal business operations. It excludes non-operating items such as interest on loans, loss on sale of assets, loss by fire, dividends and interest received on investments, and profit on sale of assets.
narration.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಲಾಭ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬರುವ ಲಾಭ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲದ ಬಡ್ಡಿ, ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮಾರಾಟ ನಷ್ಟ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆಯ ಆದಾಯದಂತಹ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲದ ಅಂಶಗಳು ಸೇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

caption.en: Net profit = gross profit + other incomes − indirect expenses. Operating profit = net profit + non-operating expenses − non-operating incomes.

narration.en: Move the sliders and compare net profit with operating profit.

tryThis.en: Discount received (₹1,000) is an operating income fixed here. Default values: NP ₹37,000, OP ₹43,000.
Raise the loss by fire. Which profit changes?
Why is a dividend on investments not part of operating profit?

problem.en: Sri Rama Traders has gross profit ₹72,000. Other items: salaries ₹18,000; rent ₹6,000; carriage outwards ₹2,000; advertisement ₹4,000; interest on loan ₹3,000; loss by fire ₹5,000; discount received ₹1,000; dividend received on investments ₹2,000. Find net profit and operating profit.

steps.en: Operating profit = 37,000 + 3,000 (interest on loan) + 5,000 (loss by fire) − 2,000 (dividend) = ₹43,000.
Check: GP 72,000 − operating expenses 30,000 + discount received 1,000 = ₹43,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Sri Rama Traders has gross profit ₹72,000. homework.en: Prepare the profit and loss account for the worked example in proper format.

narration.en: Recap. The profit and loss account starts with gross profit. Indirect expenses are debited; other incomes are credited. Net profit is added to capital. Operating profit excludes non-operating items.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪರೋಕ್ಷ ವೆಚ್ಚಗಳು ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗೆ; ಇತರ ಆದಾಯಗಳು ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ಗೆ. ನಿವ್ವಳ ಲಾಭವನ್ನು ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣೆಯಲ್ಲದ ಅಂಶಗಳು ಸೇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
